units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 1:6">Gitt. I, 6</cite> <he>תֵּן גט וכ׳</he> give this letter of divorce to my wife.
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 1:6">Ib.</cite> <he>תְּנוּ גט וכ׳</he> give ye &c.
Ib. לא יִתְּנוּ לאחר מיתה they must not deliver it after the man’s death; a. v. fr.—נשא ונ׳, v. נָשָׂא.—נ׳ עיניו ל (to put an eye upon) to intend.
B. Mets. 19ᵃ, a. e. כיון שנ׳ ע׳ לגרשה as soon as he has resolved to divorce her; a. fr.—נ׳ עיניו ב (to have an eye on) to desire, think of.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 11:12">Ned. XI, 12</cite> <he>שלא תהא אשה נוֹתֶנֶת עיניה באחר</he> lest the woman have a liking for another man.
<cite ref="Nedarim 20b:2">Ib. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא אֶתֵּן עיני וכ׳</he> lest I think of another woman.
Ib. אל ישתה … ויִתֵּן וכ׳ one must not drink of one cup (have connection with one woman) and think of another; a. fr.—Esp. נ׳ עיניו בו to cast an angry eye at, to hurt by an angry look.

<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:12">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ ע׳ בו ונעשה וכ׳</he> he cast an eye at him and he was changed into &c., v. <cite ref="C00848"><he>גַּל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 34a:2">Sabb. 34ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—
Y. Ber. III, beg. 5ᵈ, a. fr. נוֹתן תפלין puts on T’fillin.—נ׳ טעם, v. טַעַם.—הדין נותן the conclusion ad majus gives it, it is a legitimate conclusion.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 59b">Bekh. 59ᵇ</cite>, a. fr.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 59b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>היא הנוֹתֶנֶת</he> (on the contrary,) it is thus we should argue.—
Gen. R. s. 33 והדין נותן and it stands to reason.—Esp. נ׳ (sub. דם) to put blood on the altar, sprinkle, smear.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 8:4">Zeb. VIII, 4</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:10">Tosef. Neg. VI, 10</cite> <he>נותן</he>, v. <cite ref="N01386"><he>נָתַץ</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Nedarim 38a:4">Ned. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נִיתְּנָה תורה אלא וכ׳</he> the Law was given only to Moses and his descendants.
<cite ref="Nedarim 38a">Ib.</cite> <he>וכולן נִתְּנוּ וכ׳</he> and all those (gates of understanding) were granted to Moses; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 81a:3">Keth. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>לא ניתנה כתובה וכ׳</he> the K’thubah is not intended to be collected during life-time.
R. Hash. 28ᵃ מצות … נִיתְּנוּ, v. הָנָה; a. fr.—[Tosef. Ab. Zar. V (VI), 8 עד שינתן, v. נָתַץ.]—Esp. to be put on the altar, sprinkled, smeared.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 8:9">Zeb. VIII, 9</cite> <he>הנִתָּנִין למטה … בנתנין למעלה</he> blood which must be put below (the red line) which has been mixed with blood that must be put above.

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 8:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>יִנָּתְנוּ במתן וכ׳</he> shall be applied four times, v. <cite ref="M03082"><he>מַתָּן</he></cite> a. <cite ref="M03089"><he>מַתָּנָה</he></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 1:1">Makhsh. I, 1</cite> <he>בכי יוּתַּן</he> (<he>הרי זה</he>) it comes under the law (<cite ref="Leviticus 11:38">Lev. XI, 38</cite>), i.e. it is a liquid which, if put on eatables, makes them susceptible of uncleanness. Ib. 2 <he>אינן בכי יותן</he> do not qualify for uncleanness; a. fr.
